capability_notes.target_backend: SkillOpt supports codex_exec as a target execution backend.
capability_notes.optimizer_backend: SkillOpt optimizer backends are openai_chat, claude_chat, qwen_chat, and minimax_chat; codex_exec is not accepted as an optimizer backend at this commit.
capability_notes.no_api_key_path: Codex CLI alone can serve as a target harness smoke, but real optimization still needs a supported optimizer backend such as local qwen_chat or a configured API backend.
